sn47.46:1.1: atha kho aññataro bhikkhu yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami. pe. ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho so bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn47.46:2.1: sādhu me bhante bhagavā saṅkhittena dhammaṃ desetu yamahaṃ bhagavato dhammaṃ sutvā eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto vihareyyanti.
sn47.46:2.2: tasmā tiha tvaṃ bhikkhu ādimeva visodhehi kusalesu dhammesu.
sn47.46:2.4: idha tvaṃ bhikkhu pāṭimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharāhi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesu.
sn47.46:2.5: yato kho tvaṃ bhikkhu pāṭimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvuto viharissasi ācāragocarasampanno aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvī samādāya sikkhassu sikkhāpadesu tato tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya cattāro satipaṭṭhāne bhāveyyāsi.
sn47.46:3.2: idha tvaṃ bhikkhu kāye kāyānupassī viharāhi.
sn47.46:3.5: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāhi ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ.
sn47.46:3.6: yato kho tvaṃ bhikkhu sīlaṃ nissāya sīle patiṭṭhāya ime cattāro satipaṭṭhāne evaṃ bhāvessasi tato tuyhaṃ bhikkhu yā ratti vā divaso vā āgamissati vuḍḍhi yeva pāṭakaṅkhā kusalesu dhammesu no parihānīti.
sn47.46:3.7: atha kho so bhikkhu bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinanditvā anumoditvā uṭṭhāyāsanā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā padakkhiṇaṃ katvā pakkāmi.
sn47.46:4.1: atha kho so bhikkhu eko vūpakaṭṭho appamatto ātāpī pahitatto viharanto na cirasseva yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja viharati
sn47.46:4.2: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsi.
sn47.46:4.3: aññataro ca pana so bhikkhu arahataṃ ahosīti.
